hook_text: 16 times 25 in two seconds. Halve one, double the other, and watch it turn into 4 times 100.
clip_script: Sports day in Rustenburg. 16 teams of 25 learners. Halve the 16, double the 25: 8 times 50. Again: 4 times 100. 400 learners. Now 12 family tickets at R199. Round to R200: 2 400. But every ticket got R1 extra, so take off 12. R2 388. Then 48 taxis with 15 visitors each. Split the 15: 480 plus 240. 720 visitors. Check by undoing: 720 divided by 15 is 48. It matches. Make the numbers friendly, then check another way.
visual_style: Rows of learners merging two by two on a field, a price tag sliding from R199 to R200 with twelve R1 coins dropping off.
mood: Sporty and upbeat, like a coach calling out plays.
pacing: Three quick techniques, one beat each, then the division check as the whistle.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and work out 18 times 35 by doubling and halving.
